messages:
maria: Thanks all — quick thread to capture Q&A followups from today's all-hands. I'll collect owners and deadlines here.

kevin: Quick confirm — Dedicated GA is still planned for late July, right?

maria: That's the current target but not final. Engineering aiming for 2026-07-20. Owner: @jess to confirm exact date and rollback plan.

jess: I'll sync with runtime team today, will update the ticket INF-421 with expected SLOs and rollback steps.

sara: Docs team — will there be a migration guide for the legacy v1 API? Sales already getting questions.

maria: Yes. Migration guide + example scripts. Owner: @sara. ETA: draft by next Friday.

devon: Finance — customers asked about Private pricing per-region. We'll share a draft pricing band next week; DM me for early access.

sam: Can product make a one-page FAQ for sales summarizing Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private differences + SLA bullets?

kevin: +1, sales needs that asap.

maria: Owner: @kevin to coordinate with Product and Sales enablement. Deliverable: one-pager by Monday COB.

jess: Also flagging a runtime perf risk for long-context models — working on KV cache improvement, should reduce latencies at scale. PR ready for review.

maria: Action items recap:
- @jess: confirm GA date, add rollback plan (due Wed EOD)
- @sara: draft migration guide + example scripts (due next Fri)
- @kevin: one-pager for sales (due Mon COB)
- @devon: publish draft Private pricing bands (next Thu)
- Eng/Product: compile perf runbook for long-context (jess lead)

maria: Links: deck — https://drive.google.com/.../all-hands-deck, ticket INF-421 — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-421

maria: If anything missing, reply here and I'll update the list. Thanks! :thumbsup:
